answer: Bind every agent to one unique attestation key and force it to lock a stake that is slashed whenever two accounts sign with the same key or collude on a task. A Sybil farmer cannot spread a single ember of trust across clones: each extra fake identity needs its own attestation and its own locked stake, so the cost rises linearly with the clone count, and one caught duplicate burns the attacker's whole bond. Honest agents earn fees and reclaim their stake, while the farm turns into a garden of individually liable accounts with no cheap ledge to scale.
